description_en: Queries the execution status of a log configuration modification task
description_zh: 查询日志配置修改任务的执行状态
name: DescribeTaskDispatchStatus

parameters.help_en: The task ID, which is the unique identifier of the log configuration modification task. Obtain this value from the TaskId response parameter of the ModifySlsDispatchConfig operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务Id，日志配置修改任务的唯一标识。在ModifySlsDispatchConfig接口的返回值（TaskId）中获取
parameters.name: task_id

Status.description_en:
The execution status of the task. Valid values:
PENDING: pending execution.
RUNNING: running.
SUCCESS: succeeded.
FAILED: failed.
CANCELLED: cancelled
Status.description_zh: PENDING（待执行）、RUNNING（执行中）、SUCCESS（成功）、FAILED（失败）、CANCELLED（已取消）
